meaning:
ἀπ-εῖπον, 2 aor. without present in use
[in LXX for מָאַס, אָמַר, etc. ;]
1. to tell out.
2. to forbid (3Ki.11:2).
3. to renounce: 1 aor. mid. (WH, App., 164; MM, VGT, see word), 2Co.4:2.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: But we have renounced the hidden things of shame, not walking in craftiness, nor handling the word of God deceitfully, but by the manifestation of the truth…
